newsitem.title: USA: Continental jet reports smoke in cockpit.
newsitem.headline: Continental jet reports smoke in cockpit.

text.p: A Continental Airlines jet landing Thursday at Newark International Airport reported a smoky smell in the cockpit, forcing the airport to close a runway briefly, officials said.
None of the 44 passengers or six crew members on board the McDonnell Douglas MD-80 was injured, according to airline spokesman Dave Messing.

Continental Flight 1192, arriving from Jacksonville, Fla., landed normally, but pilots noticed the smell once the plane was on the ground, Messing said. The smoke was believed to be due to a malfunction in the plane's air conditioning system, he said.
The plane was towed to a hangar and there was no evacuation of passengers, said Arlene Salac, a spokeswoman for the Federal Aviation Administration.
